description: Prior resolved CPE cases and responsibility-boundary procedures.

documents.signature: Modem online after reboot but service profile mismatched account tier; config file stale
documents.resolution: Re-provisioned modem, pushed correct config file

documents.signature: CPE reachable, downstream power and SNR within spec, provisioned tier differs from service record
Repeated modem reboots, uptime under ten minutes, firmware two builds behind
documents.resolution: Firmware upgrade cleared the reboot loop

documents.signature: Wired speed test passes at tier, wireless throughput poor, channel utilisation high, many clients
documents.resolution: Wi-Fi band steering and channel change, self help

documents.signature: Elevated codeword errors and low upstream power at CPE, levels correct at the tap, drop cable weathered
Intermittent SNR dips at one premise only, neighbours on same tap unaffected, ground block corroded
Codeword errors and ingress at several premises on the same tap, tap port oxidised
Upstream ingress visible across multiple subscribers sharing the tap, coastal aerial plant, salt corrosion
Low downstream power at the tap itself, not only at the CPE, amplifier upstream reading normal
Single premise low power, tap reading nominal, splitter in home degraded
Simultaneous alarms across many CPEs on one node, node utilisation at ceiling
documents.resolution: Node split scheduled, no customer dispatch

documents.signature: Amplifier alarm and degraded levels for entire node leg after storm, power supply fault
ONT online, optical Rx within budget, service VLAN mismatched after plan change
ONT dying gasp then recovery, local power unstable, optical levels nominal
OMCI state inconsistent after tariff change, optical Rx and Tx nominal
Optical path clean, ONT Ethernet fine, wireless coverage poor in far rooms
Optical Rx low at ONT, level correct at the drop terminal, patch cord bent past radius
documents.resolution: Replaced patch cord and drop fibre

documents.signature: Single subscriber optical Rx degraded, ODP port reading nominal, connector dirty at premise
Optical Rx low for several subscribers on the same ODP, splitter port contaminated
documents.resolution: ODP splitter port cleaned and re-tested, MR raised

documents.signature: Loss of signal LOS for a group of ONTs behind one ODP, feeder fibre damaged
documents.resolution: Feeder fibre spliced, MR closed by plant

documents.signature: High ODN loss measured at the ODP itself, individual drops within spec
Optical Rx marginal at one ONT only, ODP within budget, drop fibre crushed under conduit
OLT PON port alarm affecting every ONT on the port, transceiver degraded
Many ONTs on one OLT report simultaneous errors, upstream transport congested
Confirm delimiter before raising an MR: measure at the tap or ODP, not only at the CPE
documents.resolution: Delimiter evidence is mandatory for MR creation

documents.signature: Do not repeat a remote action without new evidence; return to RCA instead
Ingress affecting multiple subscribers on one tap is plant responsibility, not the drop
Optical loss measured at the ODP that exceeds design budget is plant responsibility
Link every work order to one incident so the thirty day repeat window stays measurable
Clean boots handover to dirty boots requires evidence, exclusions, skills, parts and access
